build.role: local rebuild with MR (scripts/build_kickmix_mr.py); not the pinned competition binary and not eligible for a receipt

metric.executed: mean Toffoli-like operations per shot (CCX, CSWAP, AND), the quantity verify_submission_dqi.py averages over its shots
metric.static: every Toffoli-like gate emitted, conditions ignored
metric.rule: one category per gate: the executed categories are defined by measurement (policy-scoped differences and the residual), the static categories by deleting a leaf region; no gate is counted twice

components.what: 10,510 executed variable multiplies, each 54 ANDs + 12 controlled add
components.method: CCX difference between two correct arms that differ in the product policy only; the call count is that difference over 9

components.what: the products inside init/del_gf2_inverse_with_scaffold, 54 ANDs each, no controlled add
components.method: the same reference/arm built with gf_product scoped to the inversion entry points only, then differenced against the unscoped arm

components.what: the products inside init_gf2_div_with_scaffold, 54 ANDs each, no controlled add
components.method: the same, scoped to the division entry points only

components.what: EEA state updates and their control, predicates, counter and halting decode, shifts, metadata, and the multiply-and-add conditionals
components.method: the measured arm total minus the three product terms; the terms sum to the total by construction, and the record checks it

residual_split.unattributed_note: the conditional EEA body and the gated overrides; the simulator reports per-shot counts by op type, not per operation, so this part can be bounded (<= its static count) and gated (an oracle lever measures what can be removed) but not attributed region by region with the current instrumentation

static_ledger.method: each region deleted from a fresh build and the static count differenced; static counts are state-independent, so the difference is that region's own gates
not_deletable: _counter_controls and the arm's gated overrides, which return values their callers consume and so cannot be replaced by a no-op

unit_prices.note: measured on the reference decoder, so they price the arm's EEA body rather than split it; the arm gates the body and executes fewer iterations' worth of work

measurement_gaps.gap: executed Toffolis per region inside the conditional EEA body
measurement_gaps.why: the simulator exposes per-shot counts by operation type only
measurement_gaps.how_to_close: per-operation execution counts in the simulator, or an oracle-gated variant per region (which measures the removable part, not the total)

measurement_gaps.gap: the arm's EEA iteration count and its cost per iteration
measurement_gaps.why: only the reference slope is measured
measurement_gaps.how_to_close: count executed Toffolis around one iteration with the existing marks on the arm

measurement_gaps.gap: whether the gated Forney body or another stage sets the peak width
measurement_gaps.why: Q is measured for the whole circuit only
measurement_gaps.how_to_close: per-frame liveness, already implemented in scripts/measure_dqi_scratch_pool.py

first_experiment.why: the largest measured region in the residual (32,856 of 94,470 unconditional Toffolis) and the one the review's 'predicate reuse' hypothesis would change
first_experiment.control: the same arm at the fixed 222 iterations, unchanged
promotion_gates: exact output equivalence: syndromes restored, measured phase, no junk
restored workspace and no unintended phase changes
mean non-product T-count and static T-count both reported, Q reported, Q^2*T recomputed from the same run
the complete regression suite, and a frozen source + record
